file: 309 Adopt Me Once Had 1.92 Million Players at Once.mp4

lines.t: A Roblox game about adopting pets once had more players than the biggest game on Steam.

full.credit: Clips: Alaska Violet; Cookie Cutter (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: In April 2020, Adopt Me hit 680,000 players. Three times more than the top game on Steam.

full.credit: Clips: Alaska Violet; Cookie Cutter (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: A year later, it hit its record. 1.92 million players at once.

full.credit: Clips: Alaska Violet; Cookie Cutter (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: One six year old in Australia spent 8,000 dollars on it, on an iPad.

full.credit: Clips: Alaska Violet; Cookie Cutter (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Today it has over 45 billion visits, and over 200,000 people still play it.

full.credit: Clips: Alaska Violet; Cookie Cutter (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
